review_notes: Static review candidate. Lean humanoid, ragged skirt, red eyes and asymmetrical crystal shoulder/forearm/shin growths retained. Shoulder crystal base is rounder than reference; mouth and hands simplified. Open cloth/panels remain; repair deformation topology before rigging.

Raised crystal projectile, second crystal hand, lean humanoid and ragged skirt retained. Crystal projectile and shoulder planes are simplified; fingers need review before rigging. Static review candidate.

Broad hunched humanoid and oversized asymmetrical red-crystal forearm retained. The service softened the shoulder and torso planes and simplified some crystal facets. Inspect crystal attachment and ragged cloth edges before acceptance.

Confirmed humanlike face, long human arms/hands and humanoid hind limbs on all fours; no canine reconstruction. Dorsal and forearm crystals retained. Mouth crystals and finger separation differ from the concept; a hind foot is lifted and contact pose needs correction before use. Review the long hands and limb intersections in the side/back renders.

Bloated humanoid silhouette, open red crystal belly, shoulder shards and red crystal hands retained. The service rounded some belly-edge shards and simplified the face and skirt. The red centre is painted colour, not a separately authored emissive material.

Very thin humanoid, elongated neck, open screaming mouth, crystal head spines and forearm growths retained. Face and mouth interior are simplified; inspect the narrow silhouette and cloth panels from gameplay distance. Its generated axis needed an additional local 90-degree correction for the front view.

Broad hunched humanoid and long asymmetrical crystal forearm retained, without adding a separate shield. Shoulder and crystal planes are softer and less angular than the reference, and some small back growths are simplified. Inspect hands and cloak/skirt openings before skinning.

Paired long red forearm blades, lean humanoid legs and tall head/shoulder spikes retained. Spike placement and torso details differ from the concept. Check thin blade tips and hand/blade transitions before rigging.

Long red crystal claws, back/head crest and forward-leaning humanoid pose retained. Claws and head planes are simplified and do not exactly reproduce every reference shard; review the hand/crystal silhouette from both sides.

Tall humanoid, branching crystal staff, long ragged robe and red crystalline forearm/claw retained. The generated staff and robe are recognizable but some thin branch/shard and finger shapes are simplified. Keep staff clearance and thin cloth panels under review.

Static review candidate. Quadruped wolf proportions, paws, tail, red eyes and dorsal crystal ridge retained. Crystal bases and fur volumes are softer than reference. Check crystal density and muzzle against side reference; small disconnected panels remain.

Hooded faceless priest, long light-and-red robes, shoulder crystals and a three-pronged crystal staff retained. Staff-tip and robe planes are simplified, and the hand grip should be checked before rigging.

Floating hooded silhouette, hollow face, long claws, shredded robe and red shoulder/tail crystals retained. Detached shard counts and robe tears differ from the sheet; verify the lower floating silhouette and open cloth panels before final use.

Armoured guardian, long axe, large shield with red crystal inset, helmet crest and shoulder growths retained. Plate edges and crystal shapes are simplified; inspect the axe grip, shield thickness and thin protruding cape strip behind the shield before acceptance. Preview framing was fitted to the silhouette to retain the entire axe.

Slender armoured figure, tall crystal helmet crest and both long red swords retained. Hand grips, armour planes and sword serrations are simplified; inspect blade thickness and crest proportions against the sheet.

Open stone ring, central star/core and detached red crystals retained without inventing a humanoid. Floating-crystal placement and count differ from the reference and several shards are softer/elongated. Inspected flat extraction-boundary debris was removed locally from the optimized copy; raw GLB retained unchanged. Flat shading does not restore every original crystal facet.

Elongated floating hooded figure, dark face, red eyes, shoulder shards, long claws and ragged robe retained. Cloth tears, hand shapes and crystal placement are simplified; check thin claws and open cloth panels before rigging.

Static review candidate. Crouched winged stone creature, claw tips, horns and red crystal crest retained. Wing membranes/hand proportions differ; rear feet do not convincingly contact the ground in generated pose. Back/tail crystals are simplified compared with the secondary view. Manual silhouette, wing and contact-pose cleanup recommended before acceptance.

Wide layered feather-like wings, red crystal crown/shoulders, masked humanoid torso, red forearm blades and pointed floating lower body retained. Feather planes are rounder than the original and red blade/shard placements differ. Inspect layered-wing intersections and thin blade tips before deformation work.

Tall masked priest, red crystal crown, shoulder spikes, ornate light/red robes, cape and crystal staff retained. The cape hem and staff ornament are simplified. The left hand is more open than the supplied grip and should be corrected against the staff before rigging.
